pages.text: After the snowstorm, the three built a snow hut.
Gugu wanted to play inside. But Gugu stood at the doorway, with a hand on the wall.
Nono and Kiki went to get food. "I will guard it," Gugu said, staying behind.
Gugu sat firmly in the doorway. Nobody came down the alley.
"Let us go inside now," Kiki said. Gugu blocked the way. "No. It is my hut."
The other two went elsewhere to throw snowballs. Gugu stayed at the door.
The sun was setting. Gugu had not gone inside even once.
Grandpa Badger asked, "When are you going inside?"
Gugu jumped up. "Friends, let us go in!"
All three sat inside together. It was snug and cozy.
